component.name: PrefixHQ
component.summary: Visual manager for Steam Proton/Wine prefixes

description.p: PrefixHQ is a visual manager for Steam Proton and Wine prefixes on Linux. Steam names your prefix folders after AppIDs — so instead of "Starfield" you get "1091500". PrefixHQ turns that pile of numbers into a proper library with cover art, game names, and a clear indication of which prefixes are still attached to an installed game and which are just taking up space.

ul.li: Visual library with cover art fetched from Steam and cached locally
Multi-library support — automatically finds all your Steam libraries
Orphan detection — green means the game is installed, red means the prefix is stale
Works with native Steam, Flatpak, and Snap out of the box
